verify every cached public resource hash
read selected rows/columns from public pangenome matrices
decode selected strain rows from the PLINK bed matrix
separate four technical QC fields from the main biological feature matrix
propagate missing denominators to dependent validity masks and force invalid final cells to zero
fit medians/scaler/variance mask/PCA only on eligible training strains

reference_and_processing.chromosome_naming: Peter matrices use chromosomes 1-16; mitochondrial chromosome 17 is excluded from GWAS autosomal summaries
reference_and_processing.gene_region_definition: not_used in V1 because full VCF and a validated coordinate annotation were not both cached
reference_and_processing.heterozygous_encoding: PLINK two-bit code 10; one unit in a 0/1/2 dosage numerator

reference_and_processing.low_quality_or_repeat_filter: inherited from Peter et al. pipeline; no additional filtering possible from the derived matrix
reference_and_processing.missing_genotype: PLINK two-bit code 01; excluded from called-marker denominator
reference_and_processing.multiallelic_handling: not_available in the high-MAF biallelic GWAS matrix; no reconstruction attempted
